tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Main page background — warm paper cream. Most of every screen is this colour.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Secondary background: the side navigation, featured bands, the Reading Room table, quiet panels. Never behind small ink-muted text (use ink-soft there).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Warm off-white for cards, inputs, menus and the frame around Tarot artwork.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, parchment, surface and every -soft tint (≥10:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholders — on paper (4.6:1) and surface (5.1:1) only. It misses 4.5:1 on parchment (4.0:1): use ink-soft there.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text that sits on parchment (4.6:1); also fine on paper and surface.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The brand colour, used large and decoratively: the card-back monogram (3.0:1 on rose-soft at 24px+), the wordmark full stop, cover blocks, illustrations. 3.3:1 on paper, 2.8:1 on parchment — never text, never the only sign of a state (use terracotta-ink).

tokens.name: terracotta-ink
tokens.usage: Terracotta for text, fills and state marks: links, the primary button fill, selected chip text and border, the active-nav bar and icon, focus ring. 5.7:1 on paper, 4.9:1 on parchment, 6.2:1 on surface, 5.2:1 on terracotta-soft.

tokens.name: terracotta-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected filters, the active nav item and highlighted notes; text on it is ink or terracotta-ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a terracotta-ink or ink fill (primary button label, 6.2:1).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Secondary accent as a mark: progress-bar fill (3.1:1 on olive-soft), the botanical sprig divider. 3.5:1 on paper — never small text.

tokens.name: olive-ink
tokens.usage: Olive for text and the switch's on state: success messages, 'Learned' tags. 5.5:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on olive-soft, 6.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind olive-ink text — success notices, study tags, progress track.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Decorative only: card-back inner rule, journal page margin line, small flourishes. Never text, never a state.

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Faint decorative wash — reflection-prompt panel, journal mood chips. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, table rules. Decorative separation only — not enough to mark a control on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, unselected chips, switches, secondary buttons. 3.8:1 on paper, 3.3:1 on parchment, 4.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Storybook night: the Reading Room table, the card back, the arched window around the card of the day. A deep indigo ink, never pure black; used as a framed surface, never a whole page.

tokens.name: midnight-raised
tokens.usage: Glow and raised panels on midnight; the card-back centre and deck-card edges.

tokens.name: starlight
tokens.usage: Text and stars on midnight and midnight-raised (12.8:1 / 10.7:1).

tokens.name: starlight-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on midnight (7.5:1) and midnight-raised (6.2:1): ritual guidance, overlines on the night table.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gilded line art and light on night surfaces: card-back drawing, sparkles, star dividers, the gold button fill, focus ring on midnight. 7.4:1 on midnight, so it may also be text there. Only 1.8:1 on paper — never on light grounds.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold for marks and text on light grounds: the star divider, small gilded details on paper (5.5:1 on paper, 6.0:1 on surface).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill — the gold button label (7.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on light grounds: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of terracotta-ink (≥4.8:1 on paper, parchment, surface). On midnight the ring is gold.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces carries the personality — headings, card names, pull quotes. Display styles turn on its SOFT 100 and WONK 1 axes for a storybook lilt; never all caps.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: A quiet morning with the cards
styles.usage: Home greeting and screen heroes only; one per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Card name on Card Detail; Reading Room title.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card-tile names, panel titles, spread position names.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: What are you ready to put down?
styles.usage: Reflection prompts and pull quotes — italic.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: DM Sans for reading and every control. Body copy stays at 15px+; long meanings use body-lg.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A time to step back, look inward and listen for your own answer.
styles.usage: Card meanings, journal entries, any passage longer than three lines. Max width: measure.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Draw three cards to explore a question from three angles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, form labels, tags.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small section labels and spread position numbers — uppercase, tracked.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a tag's dot and text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between stacked label and input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; card-grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile page gutter; card-grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a page; desktop card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room on Home and Reading Room.

radius.note: Soft paper corners — small, never bubbly.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs' inner artwork, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the featured card band.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The frame of a Tarot card (vintage rounded corner).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch track, progress bar, numbered position badges.

shadow.note: Paper rests on paper: borders do most of the work; shadows are barely there. Only night surfaces get a gold glow.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Cards and Tarot frames at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered card tile, a drawn card settling, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Candle-gold halo on night surfaces only: a face-down card under the pointer, the card in flight, a chosen pile.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of reading text (meanings, journal).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Desktop side navigation width.
